# S40 Fietsservice Nijkerk

> S40 Fietsservice is a workshop and shop for road bikes, gravel bikes, BMX, track bikes and triathlon bikes at Singel 40 in Nijkerk, the Netherlands. Cyclists who help cyclists: more than twenty years of experience in Europe, UCI certification and experience as a mechanic in UCI teams. Maintenance, repair, bike fit and custom bike builds.

## Websites

- [English](https://en.s40.nl): workshop, services, frequently asked questions, routes, blog and contact
- [Nederlands (main site)](https://s40.nl): the same site in Dutch

## Contact

- Address: Singel 40, 3861 AE Nijkerk, the Netherlands
- Phone: +31 6 26980438
- Email: service@s40.nl
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/s40service/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/s40-fietsservice/
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=13330340953958264063
- Opening hours: Tuesday to Friday 10:00-18:00, Saturday 10:00-16:00, closed Sunday and Monday. Walk-ins welcome without an appointment.
- Company: S40 Fietsservice B.V., KvK 42080401, VAT NL869616250B01
- Languages: Dutch, English, Polish

## What S40 Fietsservice does

- Maintenance and repair of road bikes, gravel bikes, BMX bikes, track bikes and triathlon and time trial bikes (mountain bikes are welcome too)
- Bike fit and set-up
- Race preparation to UCI rules
- Custom bike builds, new or second-hand, with purchase advice
- Sale of bikes (custom builds too), parts and accessories
- Also takes on jobs other workshops turn down; the investigation and the search for the best solution are not charged
- Usual turnaround: 24 hours. Prices on request.
- No pick-up and delivery, no mobile service, no bike rental
- Brands: YOONIT and Cyclon (dealer), Izumi chains
